question: Use Similarity Network Fusion (SNF) to integrate gene expression and copy number variation profiles from tumor samples. Construct similarity (affinity) matrices for each view, then fuse them into a single multi-view similarity matrix. Apply spectral clustering with 3 clusters to the fused matrix and obtain the final cluster assignments.

expected_output.guidelines: 3 clusters should be present. SNF results vary with implementation-specific hyperparameters (neighborhood size, fusion iterations), so exact agreement is not required. Under the best label permutation, at least 60% of samples should be assigned to the same cluster as in the reference. Column order and header labels may differ.
